bullets.title: NVDA: MS reinstates as Top Pick ($300 PT); $150B buyback; Feynman drives $60B/GW
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley reinstated NVDA as Top Pick (OW, $300 PT ~20x CY27 EPS) after constructive NDR meetings, citing diverse customer base (~50% ACIE segment), Feynman generation targeting >$50B revenue/GW, and 10x agentic inference token demand. NVDA separately announced a $150B increase to share buyback authorization to $235B total through FY28. Stock valued at ~15x FY28 EPS; bull case $350, bear case $160.

bullets.title: MU: Massive beat-and-raise; >75% of CY27 output committed; 100% FCF return starting Dec 9
bullets.body: Micron F4Q revenue $54.23B beat consensus $51.33B; F1Q27 guided $61.5B vs $57.6B consensus; 26 SCAs now cover >35% of revenue through 2030 at above-peak margins (GM floor 86.25%). Management expects CY27/28 supply-demand tighter than CY26 with HBM4 pricing up 100-150% YoY. Plans to return 100% of excess cash via buybacks beginning Dec 9 2026. Raymond James raises PT to $1,500; UBS maintains $1,625; Wolfe raises FY27 EPS to $174.

bullets.title: ACN: Record Q4 beat (+7% CC vs 1-5% guide); FY27 guided +3-6% CC; bookings inflect to +5%
bullets.body: Accenture F4Q revenue $18.68B crushed guidance ($17.75-18.4B); EPS $3.29 vs $3.18 consensus. FY27 guidance +3-6% CC revenue growth, EPS $14.39-14.81, FCF $11.0-11.8B. Bookings inflected to +5% YoY from -3% in F3Q, with $22.2B total including 141 deals >$100M. AI partner bookings surged 3x, AI-related revenue doubled YoY. Stock +17-18% on day; UBS upgrades to Buy; JPM raises outlook. Citi raises PT to $220.

bullets.title: META: Enterprise Platform launches; Muse hits 3M weekly users; $800 PT from MS
bullets.body: META launched Meta Enterprise Platform (Muse agent, Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code) and hired MongoDB CEO CJ Desai as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer. Muse surpassed 3M weekly users and 5M downloads in 22 days (faster than ChatGPT). Morgan Stanley maintains Top Pick with $775 PT citing ~$30tn agentic TAM, and flags CPU demand for ~600M vCPUs to serve 1B DAUs. Hedgeye and MS both flag META as an 'alpha dog' in mega-cap tech alongside MSFT.

bullets.title: MDB: CEO Desai departs to META (-18-26% reaction); Ittycheria returns as interim CEO
bullets.body: MongoDB CEO CJ Desai stepped down effective immediately to join Meta as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer; Dev Ittycheria (CEO 2014-2025) returned as interim CEO. Company reaffirmed Q3/FY27 guidance and investor day proceeded. The departure removed Desai's enterprise go-to-market relationships built since Nov 2025. Analysts broadly maintain buy ratings on valuation (7x CY27 sales) but flag near-term uncertainty; Wolfe holds $500 PT with Outperform.

bullets.title: STX/WDC: Down 11%/8% on Toshiba HDD capacity doubling; Citi says buy the dip ($1,300/$740 PT)
bullets.body: Toshiba announced plans to double HDD production capacity in FY27 with a ¥60B ($380M) Philippines factory expansion. STX fell ~11% and WDC ~8% on the news. Citi maintains Buy on both (STX $1,300, WDC $740 at 23x FY28 EPS), arguing Toshiba lacks internal media/heads sourcing, lags on max-capacity drives (30-34TB vs 40+TB for STX/WDC), and supply-demand gap remains >300 EB with capacity sold through CY28. MS also recommends buying the dip.

bullets.title: LITE/COHR: +7-11% on FCC optical transceiver restriction signal; MS sees tailwind at 3.2T
bullets.body: Optical component stocks surged on reports that FCC likely to restrict China-built transceivers starting at the 3.2T generation (~2028 ramp). LITE +7.7%, COHR +10.9%, FN +6.4% on the day. Morgan Stanley and MS both argue LITE/COHR benefit as laser component share becomes more important; the 65% US-content BOM workaround keeps module vendors viable but LITE/COHR laser margins (50%+) are the primary read-through. US transceiver capacity ~8x smaller than Chinese so no near-term wholesale displacement.

bullets.title: MRVL: Investor Day Oct 6 – XPU attach opportunity; Piper sees $45B revenue and ~$19 EPS by FY31
bullets.body: Marvell's Oct 6 Investor Day expected to introduce new LT financial model potentially to FY31 with $45B revenues and ~$19 EPS (45% CAGR per Piper). Citi expects 2030 EPS of $15-20 with 40%+ AI infrastructure CAGR and material raises to TAM targets. Key: XPU Attach opportunity across NICs, CXL, optics, switching, and NPO design wins at Google (~$10B+ FY29 custom revenue). MediaTek TPU v8 delays and potential v9 shift to MRVL are incrementally positive.

bullets.title: AVGO: UBS Buy $470 PT; AI revenue to at least double FY27 and again FY28; $42B Anthropic deal
bullets.body: Broadcom NDR with CEO/CFO confirmed F2027/F2028 AI revenue guidance biased higher (at least doubling each year), with 4-5GW/yr TPU shipments in CY27. UBS maintains $470 PT based on 17x EV/FCF on CY27 Software FCF ($31.2B) and 30x on Semis FCF ($60.4B). Separately, AVGO agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42B for infrastructure purchases (convertible debt), expanding its strategic relationship with the frontier AI lab.

bullets.title: HPE: Upgraded to Outperform at Daiwa ($75 PT); Networking Day raises FY27 growth to high-teens/low-20%
bullets.body: HPE upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Daiwa with PT raised to $75 from $65. HPE's Networking Day confirmed FY27 data center networking at low-to-high 50s% CAGR, overall Networking high-teens to low-20% growth vs prior +8-12%. Secured $1.2B Vultr AMD Helios AI Rack order. Juniper synergies raised to $800M annually by FY28 (from $600M). Morgan Stanley raises PT to $72; Citi raises to $92. Stock +5.8% on Oct 2 pre-market to 52-week high +174% YTD.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Gemini 4 Argon launch; Citi reiterates Buy $447 PT; JPM raises PT to $420
bullets.body: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon, ranking top in 14 of 19 benchmarks vs GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, with 1M-token output limit and aggressive pricing ($2/$10 per 1M input/output tokens, 95% discount on cached input). Citi reiterates Buy $447 PT saying Argon removes key overhang. JPM raises PT to $420 (Dec-27) noting TPU monetization ($4-7B in 2026, $30B+ in 2027) as key upside. Court also dismissed Chegg/Penske antitrust suits against Google.

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone Duo assembly yields ~60% limiting supply; Vision Pro pushed to late 2028/early 2029
bullets.body: Apple iPhone Duo showing ~60% final assembly yields mid-September, expected to take 6-12 months to normalize, limiting supply and raising lead times. Vision Pro lacks product-market fit and has been pushed to late 2028/early 2029 with the Vision team on 'life support.' New CEO reorganization creating higher execution risk. Morgan Stanley maintains OW at $355 PT but flags valuation as 'full' at 35x CY27 EPS awaiting better re-entry. Hedgeye remains bullish (buy range $325-341).

bullets.title: DKNG: Short bias at Hedgeye on challenging Q4 setup; DKeX grew 22x in September
bullets.body: Hedgeye maintains DKNG Short Bias into Q4 2027, flagging that prediction market spending in FY26 will exceed prior $200-300M guidance and press on EBITDA guidance of $700-900M. In contrast, DKNG's DKeX grew 22x MoM to ~$2B contracts in September (2.8% market share); JPM sees monthly combo volume reaching $350-420M by year-end. Regulatory risk is elevated: 6th Circuit ruled against prediction markets, SCOTUS case expected mid-2027.

bullets.title: MSFT: JPM reiterates OW $625 PT; Cloud ROIC stabilizing 32-33%; Copilot Super App >30M paid subs
bullets.body: JPM analysis shows Microsoft Cloud ROIC at ~37% FY26, expected to stabilize at 32-33% FY27-31 as capex scales, with Agents & Infra segment at 50%+ operating margins on $268B revenue. Microsoft Copilot Super App surpassed 30M paid subs. Hedgeye names MSFT as one of the top two 'alpha dogs' in mega-cap tech. JPM's Oct 6 webinar with TD SYNNEX distributor on Copilot/M365 could provide distribution channel color.

bullets.title: SHOP: MS sees as 'agnostic Agentic commerce winner'; money transmitter license adds 2% GP upside
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley calls SHOP a primary beneficiary of agentic ecommerce via transaction-based monetization and launched Canvas AI store-builder. Shopify Payments penetration at 68% in Q2. Analyst notes nationwide money transmitter license pursuit could add ~2% GP and ~5% EBIT uplift by 2028. Shop Pay GMV +53% YoY in Q2 to ~$41B; now integrated into META Muse and Instinct AI shopping agents.

bullets.title: CCL: FY yield raised 55bps to +2.3%; FY EPS to $2.24; 2027 booked at record pricing
bullets.body: Carnival delivered a clean Q3 beat (EPS $1.43 vs $1.35 guide; EBITDA $2.99B vs $2.88B guide) with net yields +2.4% vs +1.2% guide. Full-year net yield guidance raised to +2.3% from +1.75%; EPS raised to $2.24 from $2.22. 2027 already ~50% booked at record occupancy and pricing. Customer deposits hit Q3 record at $7.6B (+7% YoY). S&P upgraded CCL to investment grade. GS upgrades to $32 PT; Citi maintains Buy $35 PT; UBS Buy $36 PT.

bullets.title: HOOD: MS upgrades to OW $150 PT; platform deepening; prediction markets at start of super cycle
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley upgraded HOOD to Overweight with $150 PT citing broader platform deepening, wallet share expansion, and stronger durable growth. HOOD Summit delivered agentic trading, perpetual futures, 24/7 equities, and 4x intraday margin. KeyBanc raises PT to $140 (OW). GS raises PT to $145 on stronger September crypto/prediction-market volumes (+21%/+17% MoM). Management views prediction markets at the start of a super cycle.

bullets.title: CRWV: JPM hosting joint equity & credit call Oct 7; Citi reiterates Buy $159 PT on Forge launch
bullets.body: CoreWeave's Fully Connected event reinforced unrelenting AI demand; Forge platform launch targets full AI lifecycle (run, observe, curate, improve). Citi reiterates Buy $159 PT (~3.7x FY27E EV/revenue). CRWV announced 10% price increases and demand exceeds supply into 2027-28. JPM hosting joint equity+credit call Oct 7 on business fundamentals and capital structure implications. William Blair initiated Outperform.

bullets.title: PSKY/WBD: Merger approved to close Oct 6; ticker change from PSKY to SKYD on NYSE
bullets.body: Paramount Skydance received court approval to close its $110B acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery effective October 6, 2026. The combined company, to be renamed Skydance Corporation and trade as SKYD, has $6B in guided synergies but will carry >4x net debt/EBITDA at peak rates. WBD film chiefs De Luca and Abdy are exiting. Ynon Kreiz (Mattel CEO) joining in senior leadership role. Wells Fargo sees complex integration ahead.

bullets.title: NOW: JPM partner checks show 5-24% growth, deal cycles lengthening 3-4 months; Advanced tier at 30-40% pipeline
bullets.body: JPM ServiceNow partner channel checks show Q3 2026 revenue growth ranging 5-24% YoY with enterprise partners strongest at 20%+ and renewals at 100% retention. Deal cycles extending 3-4 months in manufacturing/large enterprise due to CFO scrutiny on AI ROI. Advanced tier (30-40% pipeline penetration) is now dominant vs. Prime (<5%). July 1 price increases of 12-15% implemented. AI Control Tower gaining momentum as top-cited solution alongside Moveworks Otto.
